note: The six review keyframes. Fixed for every review round: real frames of the desktop walk (1600 x 900), rendered by `node corridor3d/render.mjs stills`. `frame` is the walk frame index; "scare" is the held frame the scare plays over (layout.js scareFrameIndex).

stills.name: 1-start
stills.why: the first frame the visitor sees: the whole corridor ahead

stills.name: 2-mid
stills.why: mid walk: the swinging lamp, the open clawed door, the dead lamp beyond it

stills.name: 3-scratched-door
stills.why: the walker glances at the inside of door 305: the closest view of the gouges

stills.name: 4-scare-door-closed
stills.why: the held walk frame at door 308, before it opens

stills.name: 5-scare
stills.why: the scare at its peak, stand-in face (variant f), as the patch is laid over the held frame

stills.name: 6-last-door
stills.why: the end of the walk: door 313 under the last lamp
